tools.name: get_media_metadata
tools.description: Query the Android MediaStore ContentProvider to retrieve auxiliary metadata for a media file specified by its absolute filesystem path.

file_path.description: The absolute filesystem path of the media file.

indexed.description: True if the file is indexed in MediaStore.

mime_type.description: The MIME/media type of the file, if indexed.

media_uri.description: The content URI of the media entry, if indexed.

size.description: The file size recorded in MediaStore.
